title: Middle Eastern Chickpea Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy meal made with marinated chickpea patties, grilled to perfection and served with a side of zesty sauce.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, mash the chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the middle eastern seasoning, zesty sauce, olive oil, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the chickpeas.
Mix well until all the ingredients are combined.
Using your hands, shape the chickpea mixture into 4-6 patties.
Place the patties on the grill and cook for 4-5 minutes per side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the chickpea kebabs hot with a side of zesty sauce for dipping.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
